"""Reusable invoice export builder and the command that writes the batch."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from invoice import line_total, load, total


def build_export(rows):
    """Group rows by invoice id (source order kept), sort invoices by id.

    Amounts are rounded per line (ledger rule); credits keep their sign.
    Amounts and totals are decimal strings. No tax is added.
    """
    grouped = {}
    for row in rows:
        grouped.setdefault(row["invoice"], []).append(row)
    invoices = []
    for invoice_id in sorted(grouped):
        group = grouped[invoice_id]
        invoices.append({
            "id": invoice_id,
            "total": str(total(group)),
            "lines": [{"item": r["item"], "amount": str(line_total(r)),
                       "tax_class": r["tax_class"]} for r in group],
        })
    return {"invoices": invoices}


def write_export(source, destination):
    destination = Path(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    payload = build_export(load(source))
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return payload


if __name__ == "__main__":
    src = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "data/lines.csv"
    dst = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "build/invoices.json"
    write_export(src, dst)
    print(f"wrote {dst}")
EOF

from decimal import Decimal
from export import build_export, write_export
from invoice import load


def row(inv, item, q, p, tc="standard"):
    return {"invoice": inv, "item": item, "quantity": q, "unit_price": p, "tax_class": tc}


def test_per_line_rounding_and_credit_sign():
    out = build_export([row("I1", "a", "1", "0.335"), row("I1", "b", "1", "0.335"),
                        row("I1", "c", "1", "0.335"), row("I1", "r", "-1", "0.100", "exempt")])
    inv = out["invoices"][0]
    assert inv["total"] == "0.92"
    assert [l["amount"] for l in inv["lines"]] == ["0.34", "0.34", "0.34", "-0.10"]


def test_grouping_order_and_sorting():
    out = build_export([row("B", "x", "1", "1"), row("A", "y", "1", "2"), row("B", "z", "1", "3")])
    assert [i["id"] for i in out["invoices"]] == ["A", "B"]
    assert [l["item"] for l in out["invoices"][1]["lines"]] == ["x", "z"]


def test_write_export(tmp_path):
    dst = tmp_path / "sub" / "invoices.json"
    write_export("data/lines.csv", dst)
    assert '"total": "0.92"' in dst.read_text()
